parameters.query:
-- Open tenders that have no assessment yet, or one made under older rules (latest version of each notice),
-- plus the practice's references and facts.
-- Failed assessments are not retried automatically, so a broken notice can't cost money every day.
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (source_id) *
  FROM tenders WHERE source = 'ted'
  ORDER BY source_id, first_seen_at DESC, id DESC
), todo AS (
  SELECT id, source_id, title, country
  FROM latest
  WHERE (recommendation IS NULL OR COALESCE(requirements->>'rules_version', '') <> $2) AND status <> 'failed'
    AND (deadline IS NULL OR deadline::date > current_date)
  ORDER BY deadline NULLS LAST, id
  LIMIT $1::int
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(todo), '[]') FROM todo) AS tenders,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(r ORDER BY r.id), '[]') FROM reference_projects r) AS refs,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_object_agg(f.name, f.value), '{}') FROM practice_facts f) AS facts,
  (SELECT id FROM runs WHERE status = 'succeeded' ORDER BY finished_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS run_id;

-- Save each assessment on its tender, and log every model call with tokens and cost.
WITH r AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS t(
    tender_id bigint, status text, status_reason text, recommendation text, explanation text,
    open_questions text[], requirements jsonb, reference_fit jsonb)
), upd AS (
  UPDATE tenders t
  SET status = r.status, status_reason = r.status_reason, recommendation = r.recommendation, explanation = r.explanation,
      open_questions = r.open_questions, requirements = r.requirements, reference_fit = r.reference_fit, updated_at = now()
  FROM r WHERE t.id = r.tender_id
  RETURNING t.id, t.recommendation
), calls AS (
  INSERT INTO model_calls (run_id, tender_id, step, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_usd, ok, error)
  SELECT run_id, tender_id, 'assess', model, input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_usd, ok, error
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb) AS c(run_id bigint, tender_id bigint, model text, input_tokens int, output_tokens int,
    cost_usd numeric, ok boolean, error text)
  RETURNING cost_usd, ok
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM upd) AS assessed,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM upd WHERE recommendation = 'go') AS go,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM upd WHERE recommendation = 'conditional_go') AS conditional,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM upd WHERE recommendation = 'unresolved') AS check_yourself,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM upd WHERE recommendation = 'no_go') AS no_go,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM calls WHERE NOT ok) AS failed,
       (SELECT round(COALESCE(sum(cost_usd), 0), 4) FROM calls) AS cost_usd,
       -- open tenders still without an assessment (more than the cap, or new ones); the next run takes them
       (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (source_id) id, recommendation, requirements, status, deadline FROM tenders
          WHERE source = 'ted' ORDER BY source_id, first_seen_at DESC, id DESC) l
        WHERE (l.recommendation IS NULL OR COALESCE(l.requirements->>'rules_version', '') <> $3) AND l.status <> 'failed' AND (l.deadline IS NULL OR l.deadline::date > current_date)
          AND l.id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM upd)) AS still_waiting;
